title: ר' ישמעאל בן קמחית

paragraphs: R. Yishmael ben Kimḥit could scoop four kav in his two cupped hands. His seven brothers served as High Priests. His mother merited this because the beams of her house never saw the braids of her hair. His brothers: Yeshavav and Yosef, Yoma (47a).
